svg.text: Ticket search: CQRS index and query on AWS
Mongo stays the source of truth, OpenSearch is a rebuildable read model fed from Kafka
outbox relay publishes tickets.ticket.created or .updated (CloudEvents, key=ticket_id)
ALT parse error or transient failure
route to .dlq + schedule retry (max 3, exponential back-off), never silently dropped
Phase B - Query (read path, with graceful fallback)
ALT SEARCH_BACKEND=opensearch and a search query is present
multi_match (fuzziness AUTO, boost eventTitle / title / venueName) + filters
FindByIDs: hydrate canonical data + live availability
refill loop: apply ticketType filter, fill the page to the requested size
ELSE Mongo backend, or OpenSearch error / circuit open
regex search on title and description (degraded

Availability is hydrated live from Mongo and never read from the index. The index only decides which tickets match and in what order, so a stale index can mis-rank a result but can never oversell. The authoritative gate stays at reservation time.
